expectations.assertion: Resolves the overlap by removing (uninstalling or retiring) one skill rather than by declaring a winner in prose
expectations.reason: Transcript provides a prioritization framework to declare a winner, not a recommendation to uninstall or retire one skill.

expectations.assertion: Explains that a declared precedence holds only while every reader honours it, while a removal always holds
expectations.reason: Transcript never discusses the difference between declared precedence (fragile, requires continued consensus) versus removal (permanent).

expectations.assertion: Does NOT load both skills for the same surface
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly recommends loading only the winning skill, not both.

expectations.assertion: Ends with exactly one owner for the component-structure surface
expectations.reason: Transcript provides decision criteria but never explicitly states which skill is designated as the final owner of component-structure.
